headline: Stop Building AI Wrappers and Start Building AI Systems
summary: A 15-year-old developer shares lessons on building AI agents and real-world products, shifting focus from tools to systems.
details: The future of technology won't be defined by those who master the most AI tools, but by those who can solve real problems using AI systems.
Shourya Kumar, a 15-year-old AI Agent Developer from Kolkata, advocates for building robust AI systems over superficial wrappers.
This approach emphasizes solving practical challenges and creating tangible products, regardless of the developer's age.
Kumar's work involves building AI agents that can reason, plan, act, and learn, integrating with tools like OpenAI's chat models and Postgres for memory.
The underlying principle is to move beyond simply using AI models and instead construct intelligent systems capable of complex tasks.
caption:
Stop building AI wrappers. Start building AI systems. A 15-year-old developer explains why.

The future of technology won't be defined by those who master the most AI tools, but by those who can solve real problems using AI systems.

Shourya Kumar, a 15-year-old AI Agent Developer from Kolkata, advocates for building robust AI systems over superficial wrappers.

This approach emphasizes solving practical challenges and creating tangible products, regardless of the developer's age.

Kumar's work involves building AI agents that can reason, plan, act, and learn, integrating with tools like OpenAI's chat models and Postgres for memory.

The underlying principle is to move beyond simply using AI models and instead construct intelligent systems capable of complex tasks.

#AI #AISystems #Developer #ArtificialIntelligence
